title: Relationship Intents
description: Intent categories used in relationship reasoning.

entries.title: Authority
entries.description: The speaker is using authority or command.

entries.title: Procedural
entries.description: The speaker is following a procedure.

entries.title: Bribery
entries.description: The speaker implies improper influence or payment.

entries.title: Discretion
entries.description: The speaker is using lawful discretion.

entries.title: Care
entries.description: The speaker is protecting or caring for someone.

entries.title: Neutral
entries.description: The speaker is merely observing or reporting.
